name: io.github.AliKarami/mikromcp
title: MikroMCP
description: MikroTik MCP server for RouterOS and SwOS: typed tools, dry-run, RBAC, audit logs, rollback.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROMCP_CONFIG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the MikroMCP router registry YAML file. Defaults to ~/.mikromcp/routers.yaml.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROMCP_ROUTER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Address of a single router to manage without a routers.yaml file (HTTPS on port 443 by default). Used only when MIKROMCP_ROUTERS is unset and no config file exists.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROMCP_ROUTER_USER
environmentVariables.description: RouterOS REST API username for the router set by MIKROMCP_ROUTER_HOST.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROMCP_ROUTER_PASS
environmentVariables.description: RouterOS REST API password for the router set by MIKROMCP_ROUTER_HOST. Never logged.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROMCP_STDIO_IDENTITY
environmentVariables.description: Optional identity name for stdio transport RBAC. Omit to use the built-in superadmin identity.

environmentVariables.name: MIKROMCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional log level: trace, debug, info, warn, or error. Defaults to info.
